issues.title: Loan Simple leads receiving duplicate tasks in post-referral and other workflows
issues.desc: Loan Simple leads were receiving double tasks across multiple workflows including post-referral and pre-referral. The root cause was a bugged filter related to Loan Simple lead associations in HubSpot, which was confirmed by HubSpot support. HAs and TCs were affected by redundant task notifications.
issues.workaround: Review any LS leads that received duplicate tasks during the impact window and manually close out the duplicate tasks.

issues.title: Automated emails showing previous loan officer after LO change
issues.desc: When a loan officer was changed on a deal, automated emails continued to display the previous LO's information instead of the updated one. The issue was identified as a product-side problem rather than a HubSpot workflow configuration issue. The fix was confirmed by Luis.
issues.workaround: For deals where the LO was changed during the impact window, manually verify that any outbound agent emails reflect the correct current loan officer.

issues.title: Post-referral workflow tasks not stopping when deal marked Closed Lost or Transferred
issues.desc: HAs were receiving weekly check-in tasks from the post-referral workflow even after deals were marked as Closed Lost or Transferred. The workflow filters were not correctly suppressing task generation for these terminal deal stages. A tweak to the workflow filters was applied to resolve the issue.
issues.workaround: For leads marked Closed Lost or Transferred during the impact window that still received tasks, manually cancel any outstanding post-referral workflow tasks on those deals.

issues.title: Offer Accepted workflow not re-enrolling deals flipped back from Committed to Offer Accepted
issues.desc: When a deal was moved to Offer Accepted, then back to Referred Active or Committed after a contract termination, and then moved to Offer Accepted again, the workflow tasks to collect closing info did not trigger on the second enrollment. The root cause was that 'deal stage = offer accepted' was missing from the re-enrollment criteria in the workflow. Madelaine updated the re-enrollment criteria to include this trigger.
issues.workaround: For deals that were re-set to Offer Accepted during the impact window and did not receive TC tasks, manually enroll them in the Offer Accepted workflow to generate the closing info collection tasks.

issues.title: MRC deals moved to Offer Accepted not enrolling TCs into workflow tasks
issues.desc: MRC deals updated to Offer Accepted were not triggering the TC workflow, leaving TCs without tasks and closing info collection emails. The issue was identified after engagement with HubSpot support and was confirmed fixed. MRC leads frequently have no loan officer assigned, which was initially suspected but ruled out as the root cause.
issues.workaround: For MRC deals moved to Offer Accepted between approximately March 14 and April 1 that did not receive TC tasks, manually enroll them in the Offer Accepted workflow and send closing info collection emails manually.

issues.title: Post-referral workflow not generating tasks for referral accepted on March 18
issues.desc: A referral accepted on March 18 did not generate any post-referral workflow tasks for the HA. The root cause was a data pulling error that prevented the workflow from filtering correctly, causing the enrollment to fail silently. The issue was escalated to product for a broader fix.
issues.workaround: For referrals accepted around March 18 that received no post-referral tasks, manually enroll the deal in the post-referral workflow to generate outstanding tasks.

issues.title: Buyer credit SMS sent at Offer Accepted stage before credit amount is available
issues.desc: An SMS notifying buyers of their credit amount was being sent at the Offer Accepted stage, before closing information had been submitted and the credit amount could be calculated. The SMS should only send at the Sale Pending stage when the credit amount is known. The issue was confirmed as a dash-triggered email/SMS rather than a HubSpot workflow, and was escalated to product.
issues.workaround: For buyers who received an incomplete buyer credit SMS at the Offer Accepted stage, manually send a follow-up communication at the Sale Pending stage with the correct credit amount.
